verses.text: "Put the trumpet to your lips! An enemy is coming like an eagle over the house of the LORD, because the people have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law.
Israel cries out to me, 'Our God, we know you!'
But Israel has rejected what is good, so an enemy will chase him.
They set up kings without my consent. They chose leaders without my approval. With their silver and gold they made idols for themselves, and that will be their downfall.
Samaria, throw out your calf idol! My anger burns against them. How long will they be unable to be pure?
This idol came from Israel! A craftsman made it. It is not God. The calf of Samaria will be broken to pieces.
"They plant the wind and harvest the whirlwind. The grain has no head, and it will produce no flour. Even if it did produce grain, foreigners would eat it up.
Israel is swallowed up. Now she is among the nations like something no one wants.
They have gone up to Assyria like a wild donkey wandering alone. Ephraim has paid lovers to help him.
Even though they have hired allies among the nations, I will now gather them together for judgment. They will begin to waste away under the burden of the mighty king.
"Ephraim built many altars to take away sin, but those altars became places for sinning.
I wrote out for them the many parts of my law, but they treated it as something strange.
They offer sacrifices to me and eat the meat, but the LORD is not pleased with them. Now he will remember their wickedness and punish their sins. They will go back to Egypt.
Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces. Judah has built many fortified cities. But I will send fire on their cities, and it will burn down their fortresses."
